summary.text: A centaur who tried to wrench up an acorn-bearing oak at the wedding battle and was transfixed by Peirithous' spear.

story.text: Ovid's narrator saw Petraeus striving to tear an oak from the earth, struggling back and forth until he nearly had the trunk — when Peirithous hurled a well-aimed spear, pierced his ribs, and pinned his writhing body to the hard oak.
